verdict.rationale: Kick documents an Activity tab described as a full audit trail of the workspace. It logs every transaction change, categorization update and sync event with a timestamp and the name of the person or AI agent responsible, which covers who, what and when. Missing for 10: confirmation that the trail covers the whole ledger (chart-of-accounts edits, manual journal entries, lock changes) and spans all entities in a multi-entity workspace, before/after field-level detail of changes, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger

citations.quote: Every transaction change, categorization update, and sync event is logged with a timestamp and the name of whoever or whatever made the change
The Activity tab is a full audit trail of everything that's happened in your workspace.
automated categorization, transfer matching, and other AI actions are logged under the relevant Kick agent
